why.title: Why write in the Jeju language?
story.title: If these words disappear, what else would vanish from Jeju? — a short animation in which a Jeju-language sign, a haenyeo, an Olle trail and a neighbour vanish and return
write.title: Your postcard keeps the Jeju language alive
write.desc:
Write what you want to say just as you normally would, and it turns into Jeju.
Save it as an image, or send it by email or KakaoTalk.
write.step-convert: We turn it into the Jeju language
write.sample-caption: Sample postcard: the standard Korean ‘어서 오세요’ (welcome) becomes ‘혼저 옵서예’ in Jeju
footer.tagline: Just write and leave your words. The more we speak Jeju-eo, the longer this fading language stays alive.

The line you write today carries the Jeju language on.
